products.name: TREEUP Portable Carpet Steam Cleaner, 18Kpa Upholstery Cleaner Machine | Carpet Spot Cleaner with 212℉ Steam & Hot Water for Pet Messes and Stubborn Stains, 5 Tools for Car, Furniture, Couch, Rug
specs: Dimensions 13.46 x 12.8 x 7.48 inches

【3-in-1 Steam Carpet Cleaner】From cold water to hot water to high-temperature steam, cleaning reaches a whole new level. Combining a carpet cleaner and steam cleaner in one, this versatile machine tackles pet stains, coffee, wine, jam, grease, and stubborn grime. Hot water helps loosen sticky residue, while steam adds deep-cleaning power for suitable carpets, upholstery, and car detail. Powerful suction lifts loosened dirt and moisture, giving you more ways to clean your home and car with one machine.

【18KPa Powerful Suction】Ordinary carpet cleaners just spray and hope – leaving your rugs soggy and stains half-removed. This steam cleaner changes the game: 18KPa of raw suction pulls out the grit that others leave behind, while pressurized steam penetrates and dissolves oily residues. And with a > 80% water extraction rate, you won’t be waiting all day for things to dry. The result? A deep clean that’s 50% more effective – and your carpets feel lighter, fluffier, and genuinely refreshed after every use.

【Multi-Tool Cleaning Attachments】This upholstery cleaner comes fully equipped: a 3.5” hand brush agitates ground-in stains on carpets and sofas, a built-in crevice tool digs out dust from window tracks and seat crevices, and a dedicated steam brush blasts away caked-on messes with heat. Plus, we’ve included a targeted cleaning solution that breaks down oils and proteins on contact. Together, they turn your home and car into spotless spaces – faster than a rag and bucket ever could.

【54oz Leakproof Dual Tank System】Ordinary cleaners often mix fresh water with the dirty stuff, or worse – leak all over your floor. Not this one. With two 54oz reservoirs, clean water stays clean and dirty water gets locked away until you’re done. The leakproof tank and hose mean you can scrub at any angle without drips running down your hand or onto your rug. And with that generous capacity, you’ll spend less time refilling and more time getting the job done – a simple upgrade that makes a huge difference in your daily cleaning routine.

【Flexible and Portable】Spilled coffee on the rug? Muddy paw prints by the door? Just pick up this 10-lb portable cleaner and tackle it on the spot. The 4-ft hose snakes behind heavy furniture and into car footwells, while the 13-ft cord lets you reach the far end of a hallway without hunting for another outlet. No strain, no limits – just quick, easy cleanup wherever messes happen.
